result.quote: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert and dug many cisterns.
result.reason: Verse 26:10 directly gives his abundant livestock in the foothills and plain as the reason he dug many cisterns. The edit retains the same question target—why Uzziah dug cisterns—while correcting the answer to the reason stated in the window.
